阿申是个爱穿牛仔服和运动鞋的小男孩。
他有着健壮的身体和足够的营养，他长得高大、结实。凭着他的好身体，他时常会干些欺负同学的事，有时也会迈开他的长腿，去追赶母鸡
或猫儿狗儿什么的，他最爱看鸡飞狗跳的场面。
阿申转眼已经十二岁了。那天一大早，阿申就收到姑妈送来的一件礼物——原来今天是他的生日，他几乎忘了。
page_text_en:
Ashen is a little boy who loves to wear jeans and sneakers.
He has a strong body and enough nutrition, so he grows tall and sturdy. With his good physique, he often bullies his classmates, and sometimes he stretches out his long legs to chase hens
or cats and dogs, and he loves watching the chaotic scene of chickens flying and dogs jumping.
Ashen is already twelve years old. Early that morning, Ashen received a gift from his aunt—turns out today is his birthday, and he almost forgot.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了主角阿申的外貌和性格特点，他是个爱穿牛仔服、身体健壮但有时会欺负同学的小男孩。随后，他收到姑妈送的生日礼物，才想起自己十二岁生日快到了。

The gift was in a square box. On the box was printed a funny round head with big eyes, a high nose, and a wide, open mouth. The most interesting thing was that this head had green hair. Upon closer look, the green hair turned out to be a tuft of lush green grass.

The grass looked really beautiful.
Ashen realized that this round head was actually made of a big cloth ball. Inside the cloth ball were wood shavings and grass seeds. If you soaked the round head in water, then watered it every day and placed it in the sun, green grass would grow on the small round head, just like a head of thick green hair.
Ashen really liked this birthday gift. He immediately soaked the round head in water and placed it on the windowsill.

小草给阿申的小窗台增添了一片绿意，一片生机。

page_text_en:
For some reason, Ashen's heart began to change; he developed a sense of affection. Almost every day, he took out his triangular ruler to measure the length of the little grass, delighted by their growth. He often thought, perhaps Mom and Auntie loved him so much because they watched him grow up bit by bit.
The little grass added a touch of green and vitality to Ashen's small windowsill.
On Ashen's windowsill, there was now a small patch of green grass.
Ashen felt very proud. He no longer wanted to send the green brain to the balcony to catch little birds. Instead, he hoped the birds would like his green grass, become friends with it, and sing a song on his green patch. For the first time, he felt that love could make nature more beautiful.
summary_zh: 阿申对小草产生了喜爱之情，开始每天测量其生长，并希望小鸟能喜欢他的绿草，与之交朋友，他第一次感受到爱心能让大自然更美丽。

Ah Shen finally remembered that Ah Qiang was the classmate who loved telling stories the most, but unfortunately, he stuttered. The more nervous he got, the worse his stutter became, sometimes even making others anxious.
Ah Qiang closed his mouth and stopped speaking. He was very discouraged. For some reason, Ah Shen also felt sad. He knew Ah Qiang had many stories inside him, and he really wanted to tell them, but the "stutter" was a big blow to him.
"I... I... I'll go back... back now!" Ah Qiang said, deflated.
"No, don't go yet. I'd like to offer you a strawberry I grew myself," Ah Shen suddenly said, as if remembering something. "But, while eating it, you can think of a wish of your own. Maybe it will come true."
Ah Shen picked a beloved strawberry and handed it to Ah Qiang.
Ah Qiang thought for a moment, then ate the strawberry. He said, "Strawberry, though..."
